extracted.intended_audience: applicants for the USPTO registration (patent bar) examination
extracted.subtask_description: Official notice listing the specific reference materials that form the basis for questions and answers on the USPTO registration (patent bar) examination, including edition/version applicability and rules about external links and updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP), Ninth Edition, Revision 07.2022, Published February 2023 (for exams through September 17, 2025); and Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP), Ninth Edition, Revision 01.2024, Published November 2024 (for exams beginning September 24, 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The MPEP is a source material for the questions and answers on the registration examination; the applicable MPEP edition/revision depends on the examinee's test date window. Links in the MPEP may be live during study but will be redacted during the actual exam.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated Trial Practice Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: Consolidated Trial Practice Guide, November 2019 is listed as a source material for the registration examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included among the official reference materials that may be tested. The guide's external links are live for study but will be redacted at the test center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Changes to Representation of Others Before the USPTO Final Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Changes to Representation of Others Before the USPTO Final Rules (final rules publication) is listed as a source material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This regulatory final rule document is a primary source for exam content. Examinees should consult the specified final rule publication; external links present in the document will be redacted on the exam.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation of the Global and IP5 Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) Pilot Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementation of the Global and IP5 Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) Pilot Programs with Participating Offices is listed as a source material for the registration examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This notice regarding PPH pilot programs is part of the exam source materials. As with other materials, links may be available for study but will not be accessible during the test.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check source materials for revisions (applicants should regularly check)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants should regularly check the source materials to verify the subject matter that may be tested, as the materials may be revised from time to time, including during their examination window.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidates are responsible for ensuring they study the correct edition/revision applicable to their exam date; updates to source materials can change what may be tested.

rubrics_metrics.name: External links live during study but redacted during examination
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: All of the Reference Materials including the MPEP, as set forth in these source materials, include external links that are live and can be used during studying for the examination. However, during the actual examination at the test center, all external links will be redacted. There will be no access to external websites during the examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When viewing the materials during the examination, the examinee can expect to see redactions in place of external links (page shows 'UNREDACTED SAMPLE' and 'REDACTED SAMPLE' placeholders). Study plans should not rely on accessing external websites while taking the exam.
